assets.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: fully detailed environment continuity key, one edge-to-edge landscape image, exactly 1536×1024 PNG at native resolution. Recipe establish: detailed environment, small scale figures, one coherent perspective and horizon, calm uncluttered sky or ceiling at the top. Flat colours and hard inked shadow planes, no photographic textures. The style reference is for ink and cel rendering only; do not copy its people, clothing, text, pose, dungeon or composition. The reference images show only the characters' design (face, hair, clothes, colours, props). Do not copy their standing poses or front-facing angles: pose, camera and expression come only from the scene text.

Kanghan Marine crane barge, anchored over a submerged sea gate two kilometres off Busan, before drilling starts. Nightfall under a navy sky, no gate visible. Named key light: the barge's cold-white LED floodlights, visible on poles and the crane platform; their light forms crisp lit decks against deep navy water. Camera elevated 10 m above sea level just off the port bow, looking diagonally down the broad working deck while showing the near black hull side. Full barge about 80 m long and 24 m wide, deck about 4 m above water. A tall dark lattice crane rises amidships, its long boom angled over the seaward starboard side; cable pulleys connect logically. Two steel drilling rigs hang ready from taut hoist cables ABOVE the water, neither drilling nor lowered underwater. Grey and muted blue six-metre shipping containers sit on the aft deck; low white machinery/control cabin aft. Four black steel harpoon anchors, each 2 m long, lie secured horizontally in a purpose-built rack on the forward starboard working deck. Each anchor connects to a heavy arm-thick chain in an open chain trough leading to an attached winch. Clearly draw anchor spear points, shackle pins, and physical attachment of chain, rack and winch; do not turn them into giant ship anchors. A single plain silver hexagon-inside-hexagon emblem on the near hull, no letters. Heavy black rubber fenders hang from ropes along the near hull; simple 1.1 m deck rail, bollards, neatly coiled ropes. Show one tiny adult engineer in grey coveralls, white hardhat and orange life vest by a container, about one third of its height, weight on one leg and one hand resting on a fixed rail. One tiny black-armoured helmeted trooper in an orange life vest near the far rail, full adult proportions. They are scale figures only. Container length, rail height, anchors, crane and humans all share one deck plane. Full-height crane visible with headroom; boat fills most of the image, foreground is dark water and hull. No ships' lettering, labels, hazard text or readable control panels. Ship hardware must read hand-inked and purposeful, no repetitive surface noise.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

faults: Foredeck harpoons read longer than the required 2 m.
Surface finish too close to a render; requires broader inked cel planes.
